mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_chat_rooms (user_id, room_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roomId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id;
INSERT INTO chat_messages (room_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES ( #{messageDto.roomId}, #{messageDto.userId}, #{messageDto.content}, #{messageDto.sentAt} )

INSERT INTO chat_attachments (message_id, file_key, file_name, file_type) VALUES
( #{messageId}, #{item.key}, #{item.name}, #{item.type} )
mapper.select:
SELECT cr.room_id, cr.room_type, CASE cr.room_type WHEN 'industry' THEN i.name WHEN 'region' THEN r.name WHEN 'loan' THEN l.product_name WHEN 'policy' THEN p.policy_name END AS name FROM chat_rooms cr LEFT JOIN industry i ON cr.industry_id = i.industry_id LEFT JOIN regions r ON cr.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN loans l ON cr.loan_id = l.loan_id LEFT JOIN policies p ON cr.policy_id = p.policy_id
cr.room_type = #{type}
SELECT cr.room_id, cr.room_type, p.policy_name AS name FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN policies p ON cr.policy_id = p.policy_id WHERE cr.policy_id = #{policyId}
SELECT cr.room_id, cr.room_type, l.product_name AS name FROM chat_rooms cr JOIN loans l ON cr.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE cr.loan_id = #{loanId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_chat_rooms WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND room_id = #{roomId};
